name: Ditto (Thailand) Public Company Limited
summary: Ditto (Thailand) Public Company Limited specializes in providing comprehensive document management systems across Thailand. Its business activities also include the rental, sale, and servicing of various technology products, such as photocopiers and printers. The company further delivers advanced technology engineering services, particularly tailored for government agency initiatives. Beyond these offerings, its diverse portfolio encompasses construction, mechanical and electrical engineering systems, and a range of information technology services. Established in 2013, Ditto (Thailand) Public Company Limited is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
